## About
Renown Roofing and Construction is a roofing contractor based in Flower Mound. The team works on homes and businesses across Dallas-Fort Worth, from Lewisville and Denton County to Plano, Frisco and Fort Worth.
The work covers residential and commercial roofing, gutters, attic insulation and storm restoration. Licensed insurance adjusters and a certified thermographer are part of the team, so an inspection looks closely at your home and you have help with the claim after hail or wind damage.
The company is led by owner Adam Buttorff and holds a 4.9 rating from 339 Google reviews. Customers tend to mention the people they worked with by name, like Adam, Bryan, Chris and Jon.

## Services
- Residential roofing: Repairs and replacements for homes, with asphalt, metal, slate, concrete tile, clay tile and flat roofing options.
- Commercial roofing: Roof repair, replacement and maintenance to keep your business building safe and sound.
- Storm damage restoration: Hail and wind damage repair for roofs around Dallas-Fort Worth after a rough storm.
- Gutters: Gutter repair and replacement to move rainwater away from your foundation and guard against mold and rot.
- Attic insulation: Attic work alongside your roof to help keep your home more comfortable.
- Free inspection: Talk with a specialist about a free inspection and consultation for any of the services above.

## FAQ
Q: If I file an insurance claim on my roof, will my rates go up?
A: According to the Renown team, it is against the law in Texas for an insurance company to raise rates based on what they describe as an Act of God.

Q: My roof looks fine from the ground. Is it really okay?
A: You won't know until a roofing professional takes a look. Damage you can't see from the yard can still lead to leaks.

Q: When can I reach you?
A: Google lists Renown as open 24 hours every day. You can call or email office@renownconstruction.com.

Q: Which areas do you serve?
A: Communities across Dallas-Fort Worth, including Flower Mound, Lewisville, Argyle, Coppell, Grapevine, Southlake, Plano, Frisco, Dallas and Ft. Worth, plus Denton County and Collin County.
